stories.title: La Junta Electoral acata la orden del Supremo y pide verificar qué nacionalizados descienden de exiliados

en.title: Electoral Board Complies with Supreme Court Order and Requests Verification of Naturalized Citizens Descended from Exiles
en.summary: Spain's Central Electoral Board has accepted a Supreme Court ruling and ordered investigations to verify whether individuals obtaining Spanish nationality under the Democratic Memory Law have links to exile. The law permits descendants of exiles to acquire Spanish citizenship.

stories.title: Oasis anuncia una gira por Europa y Estados Unidos para 2027 con dos conciertos en Barcelona el 10 y 11 de julio

en.title: Oasis Announces European and US Tour for 2027 with Two Barcelona Concerts on July 10 and 11
en.summary: The Gallagher brothers' band Oasis has announced a 2027 world tour starting May 21 in Glasgow and ending September 19 in Knebworth, including two Barcelona dates in July.

stories.title: El CIS de Tezanos veta la valoración ciudadana sobre la gestión de Sánchez en la crisis de Ceuta

en.title: CIS Survey Excludes Citizens' Assessment of Sánchez's Government Management During Ceuta Crisis
en.summary: Spain's Centre for Sociological Research has removed questions from its September survey allowing citizens to evaluate the government's direct handling of a border crisis in Ceuta that occurred in late July.

stories.title: Oasis anuncia nueva gira con parada doble en Barcelona

en.title: Oasis Announces New Tour with Double Stop in Barcelona
en.summary: Oasis has announced Oasis Live '27, a 38-concert world tour across multiple countries in 2027, featuring two performances in Barcelona on July 10 and 11 at the Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys.

stories.title: Oasis anuncia una gira mundial para 2027 y ofrecerá dos conciertos en julio en Barcelona

en.title: Oasis announces world tour for 2027 with two concerts in July in Barcelona
en.summary: Oasis is planning a global tour in 2027 that includes two performances in Barcelona in July. This marks the band's return to Spain since their 2009 appearance at the Benicàssim festival, a month before their initial breakup.

stories.title: Oasis anuncia dos conciertos en julio en Barcelona, única parada en España de su nueva gira

en.title: Oasis announces two concerts in July in Barcelona, only Spanish stop on new tour
en.summary: Oasis will perform two concerts in Barcelona as their sole Spanish venue for the upcoming tour covering Europe and the United States. Ticket sales are scheduled to begin between September 25 and 27.

stories.title: La Junta Electoral ejecuta la paralización de la 'ley de nietos' y pide informes a los consulados sobre el nexo de los nacionalizados con el exilio

en.title: Electoral Board executes suspension of 'grandchildren's law' and requests consulate reports on naturalized citizens' exile connections
en.summary: The Electoral Board has implemented a halt to the Democratic Memory Law and ordered verification of links between naturalized citizens and exile. The Electoral Census Office and consular registries are tasked with examining individuals who have obtained or are seeking Spanish nationality under this legislation.

stories.title: La Junta Electoral acata dividida el mandato del Supremo sobre la ‘ley de nietos’

en.title: Electoral Board divided in complying with Supreme Court order on 'grandchildren's law'
en.summary: The Electoral Board members are divided over the Supreme Court's suspension of voting rights for naturalized citizens under the law. Most board members disagreree with the suspension being implemented without allowing affected individuals to present their arguments.

stories.title: El PSOE baja dos puntos por la crisis de Ceuta en el CIS de Tezanos, que le mantiene con 5,5 puntos sobre el PP

en.title: PSOE drops two points due to Ceuta crisis in Tezanos' CIS, maintaining 5.5-point lead over PP
en.summary: A Spanish polling institute shows the Socialist party losing support following a political crisis in Ceuta, though it retains a lead of 5.5 percentage points over the conservative opposition.

stories.title: El CIS reduce a 5,5 puntos la ventaja del PSOE sobre el PP tras la crisis de Ceuta

en.title: CIS reduces PSOE's lead over PP to 5.5 points after Ceuta crisis
en.summary: Polling data shows the Socialist party's advantage narrowing following the Ceuta crisis, while far-right Vox gains ground and left-wing parties adjust their standings.

stories.title: La española asesinada en México era de Canarias y estudiaba Educación Infantil en la Universidad de Granada

en.title: The Spanish woman killed in Mexico was from the Canary Islands and studied Early Childhood Education at the University of Granada
en.summary: A Canary Islands student participating in an exchange program in Mexico was killed. Her university held a moment of silence to remember her.

stories.title: Asesinada en México una estudiante española de intercambio de 21 años

en.title: Spanish exchange student, 21 years old, killed in Mexico
en.summary: A young Spanish student participating in an exchange program was killed in Mexico, prompting authorities to open a femicide investigation.

stories.title: Puig compra el 50% que no tenía de Isdin a Esteve por 1.200 millones

en.title: Puig buys 50% stake in Isdin from Esteve for 1.2 billion euros
en.summary: A luxury goods group completed the acquisition of the remaining half of a Spanish skincare and dermocosmetics company from another firm for 1.2 billion euros.

stories.title: El Ibex cae hasta los 19.500 puntos arrastrado por el petróleo y la IA

en.title: Ibex falls to 19,500 points dragged down by oil and AI
en.summary: Spain's Ibex index declined as rising oil prices and weakness in technology stocks, particularly those linked to artificial intelligence, weighed on European markets during a week focused on Federal Reserve decisions.

stories.title: Trump asegura que Rusia y Ucrania han pactado no atacar "objetivos energéticos"

en.title: Trump claims Russia and Ukraine have agreed not to attack "energy targets"
en.summary: The U.S. president stated that the Ukraine conflict, rather than the Iran situation, is responsible for rising diesel prices.

stories.title: El Círculo de Empresarios reclama una reforma inmediata de la normativa migratoria

en.title: Business Circle demands immediate reform of migration regulations
en.summary: A business organization called for a new bilateral framework with Morocco to establish effective border controls, facilitate immediate returns, and create legal pathways for labor migration.

stories.title: El euríbor se dispara al 3,31% tras la segunda mayor subida del año

en.title: Euribor surges to 3.31% after second-largest increase of the year
en.summary: The reference interest rate index rose significantly, signaling expectations for continued rapid interest rate increases in the eurozone.
